example: An eminent economist has been invited to deliver the keynote address at the upcoming regional trade summit. (一位傑出的經濟學家受邀在即將到來的區域貿易高峰會發表主題演說。)
The firm is investing in new technology to reduce carbon emission levels across its manufacturing plants. (該公司正投資新技術，以降低其製造廠的碳排放量。)
The board gave an emphatic approval to the new merger plan, signaling strong support for the strategic move. (董事會對新的合併計畫給予了堅決的批准，象徵對此策略行動的強力支持。)
Our management philosophy is to empower employees by giving them the autonomy to make decisions in their roles. (我們的管理哲學是透過給予員工決策自主權來賦權他們。)
Please ensure the storage area is completely empty before we begin the inventory assessment tomorrow morning. (在我們明日清晨開始庫存評估前，請確保儲存區已完全淨空。)
The cleaning staff is responsible to empty a trash can in every workstation at the end of each workday. (清潔人員負責在每個工作日結束時，倒掉每個工作站的垃圾桶。)
The enactment of the new labor laws has required us to adjust our employee benefit packages accordingly. (新勞動法的頒布，要求我們相應調整員工福利方案。)
Please find the signed contract enclosed for your review, along with the detailed breakdown of the service fees. (隨信附上簽署後的合約供您審閱，以及服務費用的詳細明細。)
Our strategic roadmap is broad and will encompass various market expansion initiatives over the next five years. (我們的策略藍圖相當廣泛，將涵蓋未來五年的各項市場擴張計畫。)
The initial sales figures are quite encouraging, suggesting strong market demand for our latest product launch. (初步銷售數據相當令人鼓舞，顯示市場對我們最新產品發布有強勁需求。)
If we do not address these supply chain bottlenecks, we will end up missing our quarterly production targets. (如果我們不解決這些供應鏈瓶頸，最終將錯過季生產目標。)
The conservation project focuses on protecting endangered species that are vital to the health of the local ecosystem. (該保育專案專注於保護對當地生態健康至關重要的瀕危物種。)
The team faced an endless series of technical challenges during the development phase of the new software. (團隊在軟體開發階段面臨無止盡的技術挑戰。)
The prominent industry leader has decided to endorse our new product, which will significantly increase its credibility. (這位著名的產業領袖決定為我們的產品背書，這將顯著提高其可信度。)
Professional athletes and high-performing employees alike require a high level of mental endurance to succeed. (職業運動員與高績效員工同樣需要高度的心理耐力才能成功。)
While energy drink sales are rising, the company remains focused on promoting healthier beverage alternatives. (雖然能量飲料銷量上升，公司仍專注於推廣更健康的飲料替代品。)
The new office building was constructed with a focus on energy efficiency to reduce long-term operational costs. (新建的辦公大樓在建造時聚焦於能源效率，以降低長期營運成本。)
We are exploring alternative energy source options to power our data centers in a more sustainable manner. (我們正探索替代能源來源選項，以更永續的方式為數據中心供電。)
Our engineering team is highly skilled in developing complex mechanical solutions for specialized industrial applications. (我們的工程團隊在為專業工業應用開發複雜機械解決方案方面技術精湛。)
We decided to engrave the names of the project contributors on a plaque to recognize their dedication. (我們決定將專案貢獻者的名字刻在匾額上，以表彰他們的奉獻。)
The software update includes a feature enhancement that improves overall performance and user experience. (該軟體更新包含一項功能提升，改進了整體效能與使用者體驗。)
The team building retreat was an enjoyable experience that helped foster better relationships among coworkers. (團隊共識營是一次愉快的體驗，有助於促進同事間更好的關係。)
The guest speaker provided an enlightening presentation on the future of artificial intelligence in business. (客座講師針對人工智慧在商業的未來，發表了一場極具啟發性的簡報。)
The new infrastructure project represents an enormous investment for the company, but the potential returns are significant. (這項新的基礎建設專案對公司而言是一筆巨大的投資，但潛在回報相當可觀。)
Please ensure you have enough resources allocated to complete the phase-one deliverables on time. (請確保您已配置足夠資源，以準時完成第一階段的交付目標。)
This management role will entail significant travel and the oversight of regional operations in multiple countries. (這個管理職位將需要大量的差旅，並監督多個國家的區域營運。)
We are preparing to enter into a new partnership with a leading logistics provider in the region. (我們正準備與該地區一家領先的物流供應商建立新的合作夥伴關係。)
The CEO managed to enthuse the entire staff about the company's vision for a greener and more sustainable future. (執行長成功激發了全體員工對公司邁向更綠色、更永續未來的願景之熱情。)
The employees enthusiastically welcomed the new flexible work policy, which promotes a better work-life balance. (員工熱情地歡迎新的彈性工作政策，這促進了更好的工作與生活平衡。)
The local entrepreneur shared his journey of starting a business and the importance of resilience in the face of failure. (這位在地企業家分享了他創業的心路歷程，以及在面對失敗時韌性的重要性。)
I will entrust you with the responsibility of managing the client relations for the upcoming project. (我將把管理即將到來專案的客戶關係之責任委託給你。)
The entry fee for the industry conference includes access to all sessions and networking events. (產業研討會的報名費包含所有議程與社交活動的入場資格。)
Please seal the documents in a secure envelope before handing them to the courier service. (在交給快遞服務前，請將文件密封在安全的信封中。)
Our manufacturing facility strictly adheres to all local and international environmental regulations. (我們的製造設施嚴格遵守所有當地與國際的環境法規。)
The outbreak of the flu epidemic forced the company to implement temporary remote work measures. (流感疫情的爆發，迫使公司採取了臨時的遠距工作措施。)
We are currently entering a new era of digital transformation that will redefine how we conduct global business. (我們目前正進入數位轉型的嶄新時代，這將重新定義我們進行全球商業的方式。)
The project aims to eradicate operational inefficiencies by streamlining our internal communication and reporting processes. (該專案旨在透過精簡內部溝通與報告流程，來根除營運低效問題。)
The construction crew began to erect the steel frame for the new office building early this morning. (施工隊今天清晨開始豎立新辦公大樓的鋼架。)
I have to run a few errands after the meeting, so I will likely return to the office by mid-afternoon. (會議後我還有些差事要辦，所以可能要到下午才會回到辦公室。)
It is impossible to escape the reality that our market share is declining due to increased competition. (由於競爭加劇導致市佔率下降，這是無法逃避的現實。)
Our company follows established protocols to ensure that all financial transactions are recorded accurately. (我們公司遵循既定的規範，以確保所有金融交易皆被準確記錄。)
The estimated cost for the renovation project has increased due to the rising prices of building materials. (由於建築材料價格上漲，翻新專案的預估成本已增加。)
Security personnel were instructed to evacuate the building immediately when the fire alarm was triggered. (當火警警報被觸發時，保全人員奉命立即疏散大樓。)
Even now, the team continues to refine the prototype to ensure the final product meets our quality standards. (即使現在，團隊仍持續改良原型機，以確保最終產品符合我們的品質標準。)
We need to implement a strategy to even out the seasonal fluctuations in our retail sales volume. (我們需要實施一項策略，以平穩我們零售銷量的季節性波動。)
Even though the project budget was limited, the team managed to deliver exceptional results within the timeframe. (儘管專案預算有限，團隊仍成功在時間內交付了卓越的成果。)
The company's recent merger was featured on the evening news, reaching a wide audience of potential clients. (公司最近的合併案登上晚間新聞，接觸到了廣大的潛在客戶群。)
Please ensure that the task load is distributed evenly among all team members to prevent burnout. (請確保任務負荷均勻地分配給所有團隊成員，以防止過勞。)
After weeks of negotiation, the two parties eventually agreed on the terms of the acquisition contract. (經過數週的談判，雙方最終同意了收購合約的條款。)
The shuttle bus to the airport departs every hour on the hour from the main hotel entrance. (前往機場的接駁巴士於飯店主入口每小時整點出發。)
The facility manager schedules maintenance checks every other day to ensure all equipment is in good working order. (設施經理每隔一天排定維修檢查，以確保所有設備皆運作良好。)
The audit results matched our internal records exactly, which confirms the accuracy of our financial reporting. (審計結果與我們內部紀錄完全吻合，這證實了我們財務報告的準確性。)
The excavation process at the construction site uncovered several artifacts that required professional analysis. (施工現場的挖掘過程發現了數個需要專業分析的文物。)
Our corporate culture is built on a commitment to excellence and a continuous desire to improve our services. (我們的企業文化建立在對卓越的承諾，以及對改進服務的持續渴望之上。)
The regional team performed excellently in this year's sales challenge, exceeding all of our initial targets. (區域團隊在今年的銷售挑戰中表現優秀，超越了我們所有的初步目標。)
Except for a few minor adjustments, the proposed strategy was approved by the executive management team. (除了少許微調外，擬議策略已獲執行管理團隊批准。)
We are looking for an exceptional candidate with a proven track record in managing large-scale global projects. (我們正在尋找一位在管理大型全球專案方面有過人紀錄的傑出候選人。)
The newsletter features an excerpt from the CEO's latest report on the company's long-term sustainability vision. (該電子報刊載了一段執行長關於公司長期永續願景最新報告的摘錄。)
Excessive spending on non-essential operational expenses has negatively impacted our quarterly profit margins. (在非必要營運支出上的過度消費，已對我們的季利潤率造成負面影響。)
The fluctuating exchange rate has created challenges for our import costs in the international market. (波動的匯率對我們在國際市場的進口成本造成了挑戰。)
The team is very excited about the upcoming project, which presents a significant opportunity for innovation. (團隊對即將到來的專案感到非常興奮，這提供了一個創新的重大機會。)
The price of the package, excluding taxes and shipping fees, is highly competitive in the current market. (該方案價格，排除稅金與運費，在當前市場中極具競爭力。)
The company organized a team excursion to the mountains to celebrate the successful completion of the project. (公司組織了一次山區團隊遠足，以慶祝專案成功完成。)
Please do not use the heavy traffic as an excuse for being late to the important client meeting. (請不要把交通擁堵當作遲到重要客戶會議的藉口。)
His leadership style is exemplary and serves as a blueprint for the junior managers within the department. (他的領導風格是模範性的，並作為部門內初階經理人的藍圖。)
This successful partnership exemplifies our commitment to collaborative and mutually beneficial business practices. (這項成功的夥伴關係展現了我們致力於協作與互利商業實務的承諾。)
Certain non-profit organizations are exempt from corporate income tax under the new government regulations. (根據新政府規定，某些非營利組織享有企業所得稅豁免。)
Employees have the right to exercise their right to unionize and engage in collective bargaining discussions. (員工有權行使組織工會與參與集體談判討論的權利。)
The competitors are exerting pressure on our market share by aggressively lowering their product prices. (競爭對手正透過積極調降產品價格，對我們的市佔率施壓。)
The yoga instructor encouraged the staff to exhale deeply and relax during the scheduled wellness session. (瑜伽教練鼓勵員工在排定的健康課程中深吐氣並放鬆。)
We have registered as an exhibitor for the upcoming industry trade show to showcase our latest innovations. (我們已註冊成為即將到來產業貿易展的參展商，以展示我們的最新創新。)
The rapid growth of the company has been an exhilarating experience for everyone involved in the journey. (公司的快速成長，對於所有參與旅程的人來說都是一場振奮人心的體驗。)
We need to optimize our existing resources before we can justify the investment in new technology. (在我們能合理化新技術投資前，必須先優化我們現有的資源。)
We decided not to proceed with the supplier due to the exorbitant price they quoted for basic raw materials. (由於該供應商對基本原料報出天價，我們決定不與其合作。)
The hotel restaurant offers a menu filled with exotic dishes that highlight flavors from around the world. (飯店餐廳提供的菜單充滿異國風味菜餚，凸顯了來自世界各地的風味。)
The company’s strategic plan is to expand into the Latin American market over the next three years. (公司的策略計畫是在未來三年內擴展至拉丁美洲市場。)
Our company provides comprehensive relocation assistance to support every expatriate moving to our overseas branches. (我們公司提供全面的搬遷協助，以支援每一位派駐海外分部的外派人員。)
The life expectancy of our high-end equipment is significantly higher than that of our competitors' products. (我們高階設備的使用預期壽命，顯著高於競爭對手的產品。)
The sales team is expectant of a strong performance in the final quarter based on current market trends. (基於當前市場趨勢，銷售團隊對最後一季的強勁表現充滿期待。)
The expected delivery date for the industrial components has been pushed back due to logistical delays. (由於物流延誤，這些工業零件的預期交付日期已被推遲。)
We are looking to hire an experienced manager who can effectively lead our regional sales operations. (我們正在尋找一位能有效領導區域銷售營運的有經驗經理人。)
Experienced employees are often encouraged to mentor new hires to facilitate a smooth onboarding process. (資深員工常被鼓勵指導新進人員，以促進順利的入職流程。)
Please check the expiration date on all perishable goods in the pantry to ensure the safety of our staff. (請檢查茶水間所有易腐商品的過期日，以確保員工的安全。)
The project manager will explain to the stakeholders why the timeline for the project needs to be extended. (專案經理將向利害關係人解釋為何專案的時程需要延長。)
We are looking for new ways to exploit our core technology to create competitive advantages in the market. (我們正在尋找利用核心技術以創造市場競爭優勢的新方法。)
The company’s exploration of new market opportunities is a critical component of its five-year growth strategy. (公司對新市場機會的探索，是其五年成長策略的關鍵組成。)
The sensitive electronic components must be shielded to prevent damage when exposed to harsh environments. (敏感的電子元件必須採取遮蔽措施，以防止在暴露於嚴苛環境下時受損。)
The company's new sustainable product line will be featured at the international exposition next month. (公司新的永續產品線將在下個月的國際展覽會上亮相。)
Please send these confidential documents via express mail to ensure they arrive at the client's office tomorrow. (請透過快遞寄送這些機密文件，以確保它們能在明日抵達客戶辦公室。)
The spokesperson gave an expressive speech that clearly communicated the company's commitment to social responsibility. (發言人發表了一場生動的演說，清楚傳達了公司對社會責任的承諾。)
The contract expressly prohibits the unauthorized use of our intellectual property by third-party vendors. (合約明確禁止第三方供應商未經授權使用我們的智慧財產權。)
The hotel lobby features exquisite artwork that reflects the local culture and the refined taste of our guests. (飯店大廳設有精緻的藝術品，反映了當地文化與我們賓客的優雅品味。)
The board would like to extend an invitation to all employees to attend the upcoming town hall meeting. (董事會想向所有員工發出邀請，參加即將到來的員工大會。)
Due to the high demand for our services, we have decided to implement extended support hours for our clients. (由於對我們服務的高需求，我們已決定為客戶實施延長支援時段。)
The exterior of the headquarters building has been repainted to modernize its appearance and brand identity. (總部大樓的外部已重新粉刷，以現代化其外觀與品牌形象。)
We have hired an expert consultant externally to provide an objective review of our internal management practices. (我們已從外部聘請了一位專家顧問，以對我們的內部管理做法提供客觀審核。)
Environmental conservation programs are essential to prevent the extinction of native wildlife in the region. (環境保育計畫對於防止該地區原生野生動物滅絕至關重要。)
Any special requests for the meeting room configuration may be subject to an extra charge. (會議室配置的任何特殊要求，皆可能需額外收費。)
Employees who work overtime during the holiday period are entitled to receive extra pay as stipulated by law. (在假期期間加班的員工，有權依法領取額外薪資。)
Successfully completing the infrastructure upgrade ahead of schedule was an extraordinary feat for the engineering team. (提前完成基礎設施升級，對工程團隊而言是一項非凡成就。)
The board emphasized that while we have achieved good results, we must avoid any unnecessary extravagance. (董事會強調，雖然我們已取得良好成果，但必須避免任何不必要的揮霍。)
It is extremely important that all security protocols are followed to protect the integrity of our data. (遵循所有安全規章以保護資料完整性，是極度重要的。)
The team achieved a fabulous result in the latest product launch, far exceeding our initial sales targets. (團隊在最新產品發布中取得了極好的成績，遠超我們最初的銷售目標。)
Please ensure that the workstations face away from the high-traffic areas to minimize noise and distraction. (請確保工作站背對高人流區域，以將噪音與干擾降至最低。)
We recommend holding a face to face meeting to discuss the complex details of the upcoming merger. (我們建議舉行面對面會議，以討論即將到來的合併案之複雜細節。)
The internal debate was prolonged by a faction within the department that disagreed with the new management strategy. (內部辯論因部門內對新管理策略持反對意見的派系而延長。)
It is important that all information provided in the annual report is factually accurate and transparent. (年報中提供的所有資訊皆必須在事實上準確且透明，這非常重要。)
The company's brand recognition began to fade as competitors aggressively launched their own marketing campaigns. (隨著競爭對手積極發起各自的行銷活動，公司的品牌知名度開始衰退。)
The lights in the hallway were faintly glowing, indicating that the building was closed for the night. (走廊上的燈光微弱地閃爍著，顯示大樓當晚已關閉。)
The management team has faithfully followed the strategic plan laid out by the board at the beginning of the year. (管理團隊忠實地遵循董事會於年初制定的策略計畫。)
The company successfully identified and blocked several fake emails that were attempting to gain access to our network. (公司成功識別並阻擋了數封試圖存取我們網路的偽造郵件。)
The company's revenue took a sharp fall in the last quarter due to unexpected changes in the global market. (由於全球市場的意料之外變動，公司營收在上季急劇下降。)
We are working hard to ensure that we do not fall behind our production schedule due to supply chain delays. (我們正努力工作，以確保不會因供應鏈延誤而落後生產進度。)
Please take some time to familiarize oneself with the company's new internal software before the training session. (在培訓課程前，請花些時間熟悉公司的新內部軟體。)
Our firm is proud of its history as a family-run business that values long-term relationships with our clients. (我們公司以身為價值與客戶建立長期關係的家族經營企業之歷史為榮。)
The current economic situation is far from ideal, requiring us to be cautious with our capital investments. (當前的經濟狀況遠非理想，要求我們在資本投資上必須謹慎。)
The speaker shared a fascinating case study that highlighted the importance of adaptation in a changing business environment. (講者分享了一個迷人的案例研究，突顯了在變動商業環境中適應的重要性。)
The brand hired a renowned fashion photographer to capture the essence of its latest seasonal collection. (該品牌聘請了一位知名的時尚攝影師，來捕捉其最新季節系列產品的精髓。)
Please fasten the strap of your bag securely before you board the aircraft for your business trip. (在您搭乘飛機出差前，請將您的包包帶子扣緊。)
We are investing in several fast-growing startups that complement our current portfolio of technological solutions. (我們正投資數家與我們當前科技解決方案組合互補的快速成長新創公司。)
Please report any leaking faucet in the office bathrooms to the facility maintenance department immediately. (請立即向設施維護部門報告辦公室廁所任何漏水的水龍頭。)
The market responded favorably to the company’s announcement of its plan for international expansion. (市場對公司國際擴張計畫的公告作出了好評的回應。)
This region is a favored location for international firms due to its excellent infrastructure and highly skilled workforce. (由於優異的基礎建設與高技能勞動力，該地區是國際企業青睞的地點。)
We are conducting a comprehensive feasibility study to determine if the new project aligns with our long-term objectives. (我們正進行一項全面的可行性研究，以判定該新專案是否與我們長期目標一致。)
